{{Quote|This trial is for the best of men.|Roggar Den|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Roggar Den''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Along with fellow Mandalorians [[Pit Rauhut]] and [[Warusman Ordo]], he came to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to participate in a challenging trial. One would inject himself with lethal poison and have approximately 30 minutes to acquire the antidote from extremely hostile [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] nearby. Warusman Ordo was trying to prove himself the best, but in the end, the poison weakened him enough for the Sand People to finish him. Roggar Den and Pit Rauhut then ordered a passerby [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] to participate in the ritual.<ref name="TOR" />
